get.summary:
Balance queries the number of NFTs of a given class owned by the owner,
same as balanceOf in ERC721

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: owner is the owner address of the nft.

get.summary: Class queries an NFT class based on its id
NFT queries an NFT based on its class and id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: id is a unique identifier of the NFT.

get.summary:
NFTs queries all NFTs of a given class or owner,choose at least one of the
two, similar to tokenByIndex in ERC721Enumerable

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: owner is the owner address of the nft.

get.summary:
Owner queries the owner of the NFT based on its class and id, same as
ownerOf in ERC721

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: id is a unique identifier of the NFT.

get.summary:
Supply queries the number of NFTs from the given class, same as totalSupply
of ERC721.

key.description:
key is a value returned in PageResponse.next_key to begin
querying the next page most efficiently. Only one of offset or key
should be set.

offset.description:
offset is a numeric offset that can be used when key is unavailable.
It is less efficient than using key. Only one of offset or key should
be set.

limit.description:
limit is the total number of results to be returned in the result page.
If left empty it will default to a value to be set by each app.

count_total.description:
count_total is set to true  to indicate that the result set should include
a count of the total number of items available for pagination in UIs.
count_total is only respected when offset is used. It is ignored when key
is set.

reverse.description:
reverse is set to true if results are to be returned in the descending
order.

cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageRequest.title:
PageRequest is to be embedded in gRPC request messages for efficient
pagination. Ex:

next_key.description:
next_key is the key to be passed to PageRequest.key to
query the next page most efficiently. It will be empty if
there are no more results.

total.title:
total is total number of results available if PageRequest.count_total
was set, its value is undefined otherwise

id defines the unique identifier of the NFT classification, similar to the

uri.title:
uri for the class metadata stored off chain. It can define schema for Class
and NFT `Data` attributes. Optional

data.title: data is the app specific metadata of the NFT class. Optional

dysonprotocol.nft.v1beta1.Class.description:
Class defines the class of the nft type.

Whaleswap notes:
- Auction escrows may be represented by NFTs whose (class_id, id) pair is
  referenced by auction records. Query endpoints such as AuctionByNFT use
  this identity to locate the escrow state.

class_id.title: class_id associated with the NFT, similar to the contract address of ERC721

id.title: id is a unique identifier of the NFT

uri.title: uri for the NFT metadata stored off chain

uri_hash.title: uri_hash is a hash of the document pointed by uri

data.title: data is an app specific data of the NFT. Optional

dysonprotocol.nft.v1beta1.NFT.description:
NFT defines the NFT.

- When used with whaleswap auctions, the (class_id, id) uniquely identifies
  the escrow marker that controls redemption of the locked sell coin.
